fields.title: Narrate shows the saved place when you switch to it, so Play starts there
fields.description: After switching into Narrate at a saved place, the view moves to that place's section once the section map loads, so Play starts at the saved word's sentence instead of the title page. Play-first-text never judges a view that has not yet been moved. Change in `narrate/ModeRuntime.ts` plus harness hardening in `main/narrate/trial.js`.
